Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.social

package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.social
JDBC adapters of social login: the identities of external providers linked to accounts, the mark of the accounts that only hold a generated password, and the Jackson module of the federated principals.

    JdbcSignInMethodsLock
    SignInMethodsLock over a PostgreSQL transaction-level advisory lock on the account: it opens no transaction and holds the lock until the caller's ends, so the removals of the sign-in methods of one account (unlinking an identity, unbinding a certificate) run one after the other and each counts what the previous one left.
